remaining_sources: Gaia-ESO identities and MaSTAR source-quality/dependency admission remain separate; no implicit activation. LAMOST alpha/M and GSP-Spec M/H are excluded from Fe/H or alpha/Fe targets.
holdout_scope: New stage protects GBS and all selected globular members as groups. Existing ancestors may contain their labels or inputs. New stars inherit stable ID roles; all products of one star share one role; unlinked binary/open-cluster dependencies remain unknown. Newly staged TESS/K2 identities are not yet admitted.
normalization: Feature scaler is identical to parent. Target normalization must remain the selected six-target parent normalization, not be refitted using new target labels.

parallax_repair.scope: Only measured parallax values/errors/availability change. All labels, roles, features, scalers verified unchanged. Input error is stored, not yet an encoder precision context.

providers: GAVO Gaia DR3 mirror crosschecked against ESA
esa_parallax_recovery.source_availability_scope: Unretrieved measurements remain explicitly masked; unavailable in this snapshot is not a claim of Gaia absence.
esa_parallax_recovery.external_payload: Public Gaia DR3 source_id values only; no positions or survey labels

source_extension.new_roles: 75 FIT / 10 TUNE / 7 CAL / 8 DEV by the same stable Gaia-ID hash; benchmark/globular references external

parallax_availability_scope: Inherited exact parent values plus native signed raw measurements for appended stars; per-role parent recovery counts apply to parent only.
